label: Reconnect protocol: server monotonic seq per stream, persist-before-fan-out, replay seq>cursor, cumulative ACKs; WebSocket is transport only.
Client mutations need clientMutationId + payload digest + server idempotency record; Pi's id field is correlation-only.
Reconciliation: get_entries(since)+leafId+get_state; invalid cursor forces full snapshot via get_messages/get_tree.
Pi-child crash window makes prompt outcome indeterminate; dedup decided by post-restart entry reconciliation, UI surfaces resend-or-cancel.
Approvals are epoch-scoped and lease-guarded: unique dialog ids, stale/duplicate responders rejected, child restart invalidates outstanding dialogs, atomic CAS first-decision gate.
Compaction firstKeptEntryId and entry-tree APIs act as snapshot barriers forcing full-entry refresh for old cursors.
